scene.en: A collector of stories. A request for help. Your first page.
scene.zh-CN: 一位收集故事的人，一份求助，和等待你翻开的第一页。

artAlt.en: Grimm waits beside an open storybook in his warmly lit study.
artAlt.zh-CN: 温暖的书房里，格林坐在摊开的故事册旁，等待你的回应。

text.en: Ah, there you are. I'm Grimm. I collect stories, and I could use your help.
text.zh-CN: 你来了。我是格林，平时收集各地的故事。眼下有件事，想请你帮忙。

text.en: These stories come from thirteen countries. But now their pages are out of order. Some of the people inside them cannot find a way forward.
text.zh-CN: 这些故事来自十三个国家。可现在，故事的篇页乱了，里面有些人，也找不到接下来的路。

text.en: You look over the scattered pages. What do you ask Grimm?
text.zh-CN: 你看了看桌上散开的篇页，想先问格林什么？
这些故事，究竟要怎么修复？

text.en: We need to find the people whose stories have stopped, learn what stands in their way, and help them take the next step. We will have to listen before we act.
text.zh-CN: 找到那些故事停在半途的人，问清楚他们遇到了什么，再帮他们往前走。先听他们说，别急着替他们决定。

text.en: Let's begin with this page from Germany. One story at a time. And when you meet someone you trust, you needn't travel alone.
text.zh-CN: 先看这篇来自德国的故事吧。一篇一篇来。路上若遇到靠得住的人，也不必总是独自赶路。

text.en: I can gather the pages, but I cannot put every story right by myself. Will you help me?
text.zh-CN: 收集篇页，我还做得来；可要让这些故事重新继续，只靠我一个人不够。你愿意帮我吗？

action.en: I'll help. Show me the page.
action.zh-CN: 我来帮你。把那一页给我看看。

text.en: Thank you. Here—take a look. Our first story begins at the edge of a forest.
text.zh-CN: 谢谢你。来，看看这一页。第一个故事，就从森林边上开始。

text.en: A narrow path leads into the forest. The next lines have slipped out of place. Before the story can continue, someone must walk that path and find the people waiting there.
text.zh-CN: 一条小路通向森林深处，后面的几行文字却错了位置。要让故事继续，需要有人沿着这条路，找到还在等待的人。

text.en: Then we begin here. Bring your questions, keep an eye out for companions, and come back when you have something to tell me.
text.zh-CN: 那我们就从这里开始。带着问题上路，也留心愿意同行的人。有了新的见闻，记得回来讲给我听。
